t: THE PRICE OF WAR UKRAINES LOST YOUTH
d: For The Past Three Years, Ukraine'S Youth Have Been Growing Up In A Warzone. As The Fighting Intensifies, The Number Of Victims Is Increasing. The Lives Of Millions Of Young Ukrainians, Like Napoléon, Plombir, Timur And Hannah, Have Been Irrevocably Changed.

The Terror Attack Of October 7, 2023 By Hamas Has Plunged Israel Into A State Of Polarising Uncertainty. Citizens Are Divided In Their Ideologies, Where Some Continue To Support Netanyahu'S War In Gaza While Others In The Capital City Of Tel Aviv Are Hoping There May Be A Peaceful Way To End The Hostage Crisis. To What Extent Can The Ideological Divide Affect Israel & The Rest Of The World?

Accused of killing 16 women but convicted of two, Goa's serial killer, Mahanand Naik, nicknamed the "Dupatta Killer," lured women with the pretext of marriage and later choked them to death using their own dupattas. After 15 years in prison, he may soon be released for good behavior, raising the chilling question: Can a serial killer truly be reformed? Does he deserve freedom?

t: AMERICA XXL THE HIDDEN SIDE OF LOS ANGELES
d: In Los Angeles, The City Of Dreams, Two Worlds Coexist Side By Side. On One Side Is The Glamorous World Of Hollywood Celebrities Residing In Million-Dollar Condos In Beverly Hills. And On The Other Side Are Thousands Of Homeless People Living In Tents And Trailer Vans In The Southern Suburbs Of The City, Symbolic Of The Unprecedented Housing Crisis In America.

t: LEBANON THE HEIST OF THE COUNTRY
d: As Lebanon Collapses Under Corruption And Crisis, Its People Fight For Survival Against Leaders Clinging To Power And Wealth.

When was the Bible written? Who wrote it? For what purpose? These questions have long remained unanswered. With the discovery of the Dead Sea Scrolls, the thorough study of the texts, advances in science & recent archaeological discoveries, one of the greatest historical mysteries is being unveiled. Unearth new information & find answer to the fundamental question: who wrote the Bible?

Founded by Trotsky in 1918 amid total war, the Red Army abandoned its democratic ideals to crush civil uprisings. Fearing its power, Stalin launched the Great Terror of 1937-38, purging its officers. Weakened, the army nearly collapsed when Germany invaded in 1941. Only Zhukov's leadership, fierce resistance, and Allied support carried it to Berlin, uncovering death camps along the way.
